boundary.description: From a junction of Heywood Old Road and private road leading to Bowlee Park Golf Range, across Golf Course to Parkfield Drive and S by a bee-line to and W along River Irk to M60 Motorway, junction 20, then S along Rochdale Road (A664), to its junction with Hilldale Avenue. W along Hilldale Avenue to the end of the road, and by a straight line to the junction of Plant Hill Road and French Barn Lane. W along Plant Hill Road, S along Chapel Lane, Mill Brow, Delaunays Road to and W along River Irk to bridge on Blackley New Road (near Roch Bank) and W along Blackley New Road, Meade Hill Road, to its junction with Sheepfoot Lane and by a straight line across Heaton Park to the junction of Heywood Old Road and private road leading to Bowlee Park Golf Range.
